title: Map Domain Errors to HTTP Responses
summary: Translate domain failure codes into safe HTTP statuses, stable problem details, and retry guidance.
objectives: Map a small domain error vocabulary to HTTP semantics.
Keep internal failure detail out of the client response.
Mark only transient failures as retryable.
constraints: Match error codes after trimming and lowering them.
Return internal_error with status 500 for an unknown or missing code.
Never place internalDetail in the response detail.
Use the canonical title and detail for each known code.
Set retryable only for rate_limited, unavailable, and timeout.

examples.explanation: A missing resource is a client-visible 404.

examples.output: status = 500, code = "internal_error", detail = "An unexpected error occurred."
examples.explanation: Internal diagnostics never reach the caller.

public.name: Not found and conflict
public.description: Missing resources and state conflicts are not retryable.

public.name: Transient failures
public.description: Rate limits, unavailable services, and timeouts are retryable.

hidden.name: Unknown failure
hidden.description: Unknown or missing codes become a safe internal error.

hidden.name: Canonical mapping
hidden.description: Every known code uses the documented status, title, and detail.

hidden.name: Code normalization
hidden.description: Surrounding whitespace and letter case do not change the mapping.
